offering_description.value: Provides long distance and voice telephone services to business and consumer customers in the United States, delivered over its own and leased telecom network facilities.

primary_products.value: long distance calling plans; VoIP phone service; prepaid calling cards

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses and enterprise accounts buying voice services; B2C: residential consumers buying calling plans

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly fees for phone and VoIP calling plans; transaction or usage fees: per-minute long distance and wholesale termination charges

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates voice network and sells calling services to end customers and carriers

geography_served.value: US national: Customers across the United States

specialization.value: niche specialist: voice telecommunications only, covering long distance and VoIP services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team selling to business accounts; online: web sign-up for consumer calling plans; partners / resellers: wholesale carrier customers and resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FCC and state public utility commission rules governing telecommunications carriers

notes: My knowledge of Covista may be dated, so its current offerings and customer mix may differ from this description.
